title: Collatz first-contraction quarter gap: formal auxiliary results and open bridges

vibemathed.name: Collatz: a first-contraction quarter-gap bound
vibemathed.statement: For a positive start n, assume its actual shortcut Collatz orbit has a first coefficient contraction at time k, with T^k(n)=n+d and d>=0. Writing s for the number of odd steps before k, must 4d<s hold? This auxiliary question concerns a conditional bound within the open Collatz problem; it does not assert that every positive orbit reaches 1.
vibemathed.sourceName: Collatz Conjecture Work: scoped quarter-gap research announcement
vibemathed.model: Astra (repository label; exact model version undisclosed)
vibemathed.aiRole: AI-assisted development of auxiliary mathematical arguments, counterexample searches, exact arithmetic certificates, Lean proof code, and adversarial internal reviews. The repository calls this the Astra pass. Exact model versions and a per-step human/model attribution log are not published; the lower contribution tier is used. Internal AI review is not independent expert review.
vibemathed.verificationNote: The release rebuilds the pinned Lean 4.33.1 source and records a headline axiom audit in verification.json. The quarter-gap theorem is checked for its stated hypotheses; its expected axioms are propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The informal-to-formal correspondence and novelty lack independent external review. Other archive claims retain their separate prose, finite-checker, or open status. This submission is not a Lean-verified proof of Collatz.
vibemathed.resultNote: For n>0, assume an actual shortcut Collatz orbit has a first coefficient contraction at time k and its endpoint is n+d with d a natural number. If s is the number of odd steps before k, then 4d<s, hence d <= floor((s-1)/4). Lean checks the actual-orbit affine identity, envelope and exact block certificate used in this proof. A supporting envelope holds for all s>=16 and fails at 15. Existence of a contraction for every positive start, universal descent, and a well-founded return mechanism remain unproved. Novelty is not independently certified.
vibemathed.submitterNote: Please assess eligibility as a partial auxiliary result, not as a Collatz solution. The archive also contains known reconstructions and negative results scoped to restricted proof methods; those are not separate claimed solves. Independent novelty and statement review are still needed. If the first-contraction bound is already known or insufficient for the site's inclusion rule, please decline or request the appropriate narrower framing. No priority, award or payout claim is made.
